detailZones.title: Glass entry and partition
detailZones.description: Trace the visible glass door, jamb, handle, threshold, partition mullions and window blinds.

detailZones.title: Credenza and storage
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible credenza, cabinet doors, drawers, handles, shelves, boxes, binders and plant pot.

detailZones.title: Conference table and cable hardware
detailZones.description: Follow the visible table surface, cable trough, power modules, microphone pods, legs and modesty panel.

detailZones.title: Conference chair seating
detailZones.description: Compare the visible office chairs, backrests, seat pans, armrests, bases, columns and casters.

detailZones.title: Display and whiteboard wall
detailZones.description: Inspect the blank wall display, camera, speaker bar, whiteboard, marker tray and wall panels.

detailZones.title: Ceiling light and acoustic treatment
detailZones.description: Trace the visible acoustic baffles, pendant lights, recessed fixtures, diffuser and ceiling seams.

detailZones.title: Floor and glass edges
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible carpet tiles, floor covers, glass panels, mullion caps and base trims.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 conference-room photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 143 independently pointable glass-entry, storage, table, chair, meeting-device, ceiling and floor parts. People, company identity, meeting content, readable screens, network state, occupancy and hidden wiring or HVAC state were excluded.
